title: [CQ-V01b] Daemon-measured approved check snapshot
description:
Objective: bind the approved protected check definitions (CQ-V01a executionContract.requiredChecks, task-80f76f99cca64dc1909765af71977e46) to the exact content identity of their protected files at an approved snapshot. The daemon records this identity itself, so CQ-V01 (task-bde8654052f648f9b209174c3708322b) can load the required acceptance overlay from it.

Deliverable: a producer contract. CQ-V01 consumes these exact names.
- types/schema.ts:
  - `RequiredCheckSnapshot = { version: 1; revision: string; definitionDigest: string; entries: { path: string; oid: string }[] }`.
    - revision: the resolved 40-hex tree id that was measured.
    - definitionDigest: CQ-V01a's definitionDigest of the measured requiredChecks.
    - entries: every blob under every protected path at revision, sorted by path, with lowercase 40-hex oids.
  - `Task.requiredCheckSnapshot?: RequiredCheckSnapshot`, daemon-owned.
- delivery/requiredChecks.ts gains:
  - measureRequiredCheckSnapshot(projectRoot, defs, revision = 'HEAD', run?): read-only and bounded the way util/cachedPlanPaths.ts findCachedPlanPaths is. Export and reuse its masked runGit, toplevel check and time budget. It runs `git rev-parse --verify <rev>^{tree}` and then `git ls-tree -r -z <tree> -- <literal pathspecs>`, parsed strictly, with at most 2000 entries.
  - readRequiredCheckSnapshot(task): returns the stored snapshot only when it is well-formed and its definitionDigest equals the definitionDigest of the task's CURRENT executionContract.requiredChecks; otherwise null (fail closed).
- tools/submitPlan.ts, when the validated contract has requiredChecks:
  - measures outside the state mutex, as the cached-path lookup does, then revalidates under the lock;
  - accepts an optional `requiredCheckRevision` (a 40-hex commit or tree id; default HEAD), so an architect can approve a candidate's tree as the new snapshot;
  - writes the snapshot in the same PLAN_SUBMITTED write as the plan, and clears it when the resubmitted contract has none.
  - Refusals: a configs or scripts path with no entry at the revision, more than 2000 entries, an unresolvable revision, or any git failure refuses with INVALID_INPUT and writes nothing.
  - An assertion root with no files is recorded as covering nothing.
- state/taskStore.ts: updateTask strips a caller-supplied requiredCheckSnapshot from every writer, as it does executionPolicySnapshot. Only submit_plan's PLAN_SUBMITTED path sets or clears it, through a daemon-internal parameter that no MCP tool or plugin message can reach.

NOT in scope:
- candidate protected entries, the delivery predicate and get_context (CQ-V01);
- checking candidate shas against git automatically;
- SHA-256 object ids (task-07474ee4);
- running checks;
- docs, held for CQ-V12;
- verified-local.
Plans without requiredChecks behave exactly as today and run no Git command.

Verification (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: submit_plan with requiredChecks persists requiredCheckSnapshot (resolved tree, definitionDigest, sorted blob entries) in the same write as planRevision. requiredCheckRevision measures the named commit or tree, and a resubmission without requiredChecks clears the field. Proven against a real temporary git repository in vitest.

Each of these refuses submit_plan with INVALID_INPUT and leaves the task unchanged: a configs or scripts path absent at the revision, more than 2000 entries, an unresolvable revision, a git failure. An empty assertion root records no entries. Proven by vitest cases.

updateTask never lets a caller set, alter or clear requiredCheckSnapshot. readRequiredCheckSnapshot returns null for a stale snapshot (digest mismatch with the current contract) or a malformed one. Proven by vitest cases.
Plans without requiredChecks write no requiredCheckSnapshot key and run no git command, asserted with an injected runner.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
The daemon's only new Git reads are this bounded, read-only measurement inside submit_plan: no fetch, checkout, writes, hooks or network, with config masked as in util/cachedPlanPaths.ts.

implementationPlan.description:
Measurement and decode, in packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/requiredChecks.ts. V01a creates this file and this step modifies it. It is listed in newFiles only because it does not exist at plan time.

- Test seam: `export const requiredCheckGit = { run: runGit }`. Production uses it unchanged.
- `measureRequiredCheckSnapshot(projectRoot, defs, revision = 'HEAD', run = requiredCheckGit.run)` runs through openProjectGit with a budget of about 5000 ms:
  - `rev-parse --verify --end-of-options <rev>^{tree}` must yield 40-hex. A 64-hex result is refused, since SHA-256 repositories are task-07474ee4.
  - `--literal-pathspecs ls-tree -r -z --full-tree <tree> -- <protectedPaths>` runs with maxBuffer 1 MiB.
  - Parse each record strictly as /^(100644|100755|120000) blob ([0-9a-f]{40})\t([\s\S]+)$/. A 160000 gitlink, any other record, or an unterminated listing is refused.
  - More than 2000 entries is refused.
  - Every configs and scripts path must cover at least one entry (`path === p || path.startsWith(p + '/')`). An assertion root may cover none.
  - Entries are sorted in byte order and unique.
  - Return `{version: 1, revision, definitionDigest: definitionDigest(defs), entries}`.
- Error handling: every failure throws INVALID_INPUT on field 'executionContract.requiredChecks' (or 'requiredCheckRevision' for revision problems), with a one-line reason: step plus failure, as describeFailure does. No partial snapshot ever escapes.
- `readRequiredCheckSnapshot(task)` decodes strictly:
  - exact keys and version 1;
  - 40-hex revision and 64-hex digest;
  - at most 2000 strictly ascending entries, each with a normalized path and a lowercase 40-hex oid.
  It returns a detached copy only when the digest equals definitionDigest(task.executionContract.requiredChecks). Otherwise, including when the contract has no requiredChecks, it returns null.

Daemon ownership, in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/taskStore.ts. Keep the file's current EOL.
- In the updateTask sanitize block, delete a caller's `requiredCheckSnapshot`, next to executionPolicySnapshot and with the same why-comment. This covers MCP tools, plugin UPDATE_TASK and board echoes of the whole row.
- Add an optional 6th parameter `daemonOwned?: { requiredCheckSnapshot?: RequiredCheckSnapshot }`, honoured ONLY when event === 'PLAN_SUBMITTED':
  - a snapshot value is set in the same fresh Task object, and so the same writeEntity, as planRevision;
  - an absent value removes the key.
- StateManager.updateTask keeps its 4-parameter signature, so no tool or plugin path can pass the parameter.
- Confirm that createTask's field-by-field build never copies the key.
- Error handling: a failed write publishes neither the plan nor the snapshot. This is the existing single-writeEntity rule.

submit_plan, in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts.
- inputSchema gains `requiredCheckRevision: { type: 'string', pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{40}$', description: 'Commit or tree to measure the protected check snapshot at (default HEAD); use a candidate tree to approve changed protected definitions.' }`.
- The handler validates it. A malformed value, or one supplied without executionContract.requiredChecks, refuses with INVALID_INPUT before any read.
- BEFORE calling submit():
  - validate the contract (pure);
  - if it has requiredChecks, `await measureRequiredCheckSnapshot(state.projectPath, defs, requiredCheckRevision ?? 'HEAD')` outside the state lock. submit_plan is already `blocking: true` for its Git fallback.
  - The cached-path retry reuses this snapshot.
- Inside submit(), make the PLAN_SUBMITTED write through taskStore's updateTask(state, ..., 'PLAN_SUBMITTED', workerId, { requiredCheckSnapshot: snapshot }). With no requiredChecks, pass `{}`, so a previous snapshot is cleared.
- Plans without requiredChecks run no measurement.
- Every other behaviour and order is unchanged: rails, size gate, path gate, approval modes.

Verification gate, run once, fresh. A shared schema and the submit_plan contract changed, so run the full suite.
- NAMED COMMAND: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test`, plus `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- Run them where node_modules matches the OS, per the epic note: on Linux, a separate native dependency install with unchanged lockfile and source hashes; never overwrite the Windows node_modules; Linux-only PATH; MOE_* unset; git on PATH.
- Supply the npm test output to complete_task.
- A failure outside this task's files counts as pre-existing only after it is shown on a clean `git archive HEAD` snapshot.

comments.content: CQ-V01a is now task-72efb0b663ec4b3da35a685ebb30ed34. The id task-80f76f99 in this description was archived before any work. The producer names are unchanged: TaskExecutionContract.requiredChecks, definitionDigest and protectedPaths in delivery/requiredChecks.ts. Note: every PLAN_SUBMITTED advances planRevision.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 6 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- The snapshot is measured as git object ids at a tree-ish, so a runner's candidate measurement in CQ-V01 compares like with like. Raw-bytes hashing was rejected because it disagrees with git EOL normalization.
- Measurement happens before the locked write. submit_plan is already blocking for its Git fallback, and the closure revalidates under runExclusive.
- A daemon-internal updateTask parameter was chosen over a new store write path, keeping one writeEntity with planRevision. StateManager's signature stays unchanged, so callers cannot reach the parameter.
- The trust envelope is extracted from findCachedPlanPaths rather than duplicated. Behavior is unchanged and its tests pin that.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- util/cachedPlanPaths.ts runGit masks GIT_* env and global/system config, disables protocols and optional locks, and trusts only safe.directory=<root>. It has MAX_BUFFER 128 KiB and BUDGET_MS 2000.
- findCachedPlanPaths runs realpath, the /* guard, toplevel equality, refusal of partial-clone/promisor/core.worktree config, `--literal-pathspecs ls-tree -z --full-tree`, and strict record parsing.
- submitPlan: `submit = () => state.runExclusive(...)`, with the cached-path retry at ~700-720. The PLAN_SUBMITTED write is at ~509.
- taskStore: the sanitize block (~410-427) strips planRevision and executionPolicySnapshot. Its capture rides the same fresh object as planRevision.
- The real-git test pattern is in tools/submitPlan.test.ts at ~796-870.
planningNotes.risks:
- V01a is unlanded at plan time. Step 1 makes the worker follow its landed names. requiredChecks.ts sits in newFiles only because V01a creates it.
- 2000 entries times path length can exceed 128 KiB, hence maxBuffer 1 MiB for ls-tree. An overflow refuses.
- SHA-256 repos are refused for now (task-07474ee4).
- On Windows, git paths are case-sensitive in ls-tree. Exact spelling is required, as cached-path evidence already requires.
- The cachedPlanPaths refactor must not change its messages: existing tests assert them.
